items.h: Catches both targets in loss
items.s: Treadwell caught both of his targets for 19 yards in the Colts' 16-10 loss to the Vikings on Sunday. Treadwell played 45 offensive snaps in Sunday's loss. The wide receiver participated in 74 percent of the Colts' offensive plays, but the No. 3 option saw fewer targets than Josh Downs and Keenan Allen.

items.h: Two catches in defeat
items.s: Treadwell caught two of five targets for 21 yards during Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Titans. Treadwell finished fourth on the team in targets while reeling in multiple passes for the third game in a row. The wide receiver played a season-high 93 percent of the team's offensive snaps in the loss, and he has now caught 13 of 24 targets for 178 yards over six contests this year.

items.h: Laquon Treadwell brings in two passes in loss
items.s: Laquon Treadwell caught two of five targets for 21 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday. Treadwell continued his trend of catching fewer than 50% of his targets. He's not a great option for fantasy in any format, failing to produce anything even in a depleted pass-catching room.

items.h: Laquon Treadwell A Deep League Potential High-Volume Option For Week 6
items.s: Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Laquon Treadwell's 14 targets combined in his last two games are hard to ignore for fantasy football, though they haven't translated into production that's made him a startable fantasy WR yet. With that much volume, he may seem like a good starting option, but his actual catches resulted in just 9.2 and 5.4 PPR fantasy points in those two contests. A matchup with the Tennessee Titans may seem solid on paper, but it could just as easily lead to a low passing volume day from the Colts. Treadwell's path to success runs through quarterback Daniel Jones, who's still recovering from an Achilles tendon tear from late 2025. The Colts may not have to produce a ton…

items.h: Laquon Treadwell sees eight targets in Week 5
items.s: Laquon Treadwell caught two of eight targets for 34 yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. Treadwell had the second most targets on the team, behind the nine of Tyler Warren and Keenan Allen. However, he failed to convert on most of those attempts, although sometimes he was the closest target on throwaway throws by QB Daniel Jones, so the targets are slightly inflated. Still, he's not going to be doing much for fantasy, so it's best to leave him on waivers.

items.h: Laquon Treadwell Carries Deep-League Flex Appeal For Week 5
items.s: The Indianapolis Colts will face the Pittsburgh Steelers' middling pass defense in Week 5, and WR Laquon Treadwell is set to start and play a large snap share in the game. Colts WR1 Alec Pierce (heel) and depth WR Ashton Dulin (hamstring) will both miss the game with injuries, and WR Keenan Allen (groin) is uncertain to play. Darius Slayton (knee) has also been ruled out. Treadwell was targeted six times in Week 4, catching five passes for 42 yards and leading the team in receiving. The matchup with the Steelers is just fine, as they allow just-below-average fantasy points per game to opposing wideouts. Treadwell has bounced around NFL teams since he was drafted in the first round, and…

items.h: Leads team in receiving in win
items.s: Treadwell caught five of six targets for 42 yards in Sunday's 30-13 win over the Commanders. With Alec Pierce (heel) on injured reserve and Keenan Allen (groin) inactive for Week 4, Treadwell paced the Colts' wideouts with 56 offensive snaps and ran a team-high 36 routes on Daniel Jones' 37 dropbacks. Josh Downs and Ashton Dulin fell in line behind Treadwell in terms of playing time at the position. He has nine catches for 123 yards on 11 targets through four games.

items.h: Laquon Treadwell hauls in five passes in Week 4 win
items.s: Laquon Treadwell caught 5-of-6 targets for 42 yards in the Colts win over the Commanders. Treadwell saw an increase in playing time with the Colts dealing with injuries to Alec Pierce and Keenan Allen. Fantasy managers should expect this to be an outlier, as Treadwell's playing time will diminish once Allen and Pierce return.

items.h: Laquon Treadwell To See Increased Playing Time In Week 3
items.s: The Indianapolis Colts will be without their top wide receiver, Alec Pierce (heel), who was placed on injured reserve after their Week 2 contest. As a result, wide receiver Laquon Treadwell is set to see a big bump in playing time. He caught all three of his targets for 61 yards in Week 2 after seeing just one target and zero catches in Week 1. The Houston Texans are coming to Indianapolis for a Week 3 matchup, meaning Treadwell may have trouble separating and making catches against one of the best pass defenses in the NFL. Houston's secondary is loaded with talent, and have had success against even some of the NFL's best receivers. Treadwell is a depth piece who's being thrust into action…

items.h: Catches three targets in loss
items.s: Treadwell caught all three of his targets for 61 yards and made one tackle on kick coverage in Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Chiefs. Treadwell played 48 of the Colts' 65 offensive snaps due to the injuries to Alec Pierce (heel, in-game injury) and Ashton Dulin (ankle). The wide receiver also logged 17 special-teams snaps, stepping up for the team in multiple phases even though it ultimately fell in a close game.

items.h: Treadwell played five snaps on offense without showing up in the box score otherwise during the Colts' 13-13 preseason tie with the Patriots on Thursday.
items.s: Treadwell had been held out of training camp practices due to a hamstring injury but was cleared to play in Thursday's exhibition contest. He didn't see much playing time against New England despite the absences of both Alec Pierce (ankle) and Josh Downs (groin), and Treadwell is competing against the likes of Coleman Owen, E.J. Horton and rookie seventh-rounder Deion Burks for a depth spot on the Colts' 53-man roster. Indianapolis' next preseason game takes place Saturday, Aug. 22, against Atlanta.

items.h: Treadwell (hamstring) was unavailable for practice with the Colts on Thursday, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Treadwell is dealing with an apparent hamstring injury, and head coach Shane Steichen noted the wide receiver is currently without a timetable to return. Treadwell signed a one-year deal with Indianapolis in March, and he's competing with the likes of rookie seventh-round pick Deion Burks and third-year pro Anthony Gould for a spot on the team's initial 53-man roster.

items.h: Treadwell and the Colts agreed to terms on a one-year contract Friday, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Treadwell opened the 2025 campaign on the Colts' practice squad before being signed to the active roster in early November. He was used almost exclusively on special teams and did not record a target across 10 regular-season games last year. Treadwell will likely reprise his role as a special teamer for the 2026 season.

items.h: The Colts signed Treadwell to the active roster from their practice squad Saturday, Amanda Foster of the team's official site reports.
items.s: Treadwell played exclusively on special teams during the two games he was elevated to the active roster for. However, the 2016 first-round pick could be in line for an increased role during Sunday's matchup versus the Falcons, as Anthony Gould is questionable with a knee injury.

items.h: The Colts elevated Treadwell to their active roster Saturday.
items.s: The Ole Miss product is now in line to join the Colts' active roster for the second time in the last three weeks. In the Week 7 matchup against the Chargers, Treadwell played 12 special-teams snaps and didn't record an offensive stat. Now back with the active roster, he's likely to play a similar role in the Week 9 matchup against the Steelers.

items.h: The Colts elevated Treadwell to the active roster from the practice squad Saturday.
items.s: Josh Downs (concussion) and Ashton Dulin (chest) have been ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Chargers, leaving the Colts shorthanded at wide receiver. Treadwell has spent the entire season on the team's practice squad, with this elevation marking his first of the year.

items.h: Indianapolis signed Treadwell to a practice-squad deal Thursday.
items.s: Treadwell missed out on making the Colts' 53-man roster, but he'll hope for opportunities to play this season while on the team's practice squad. The veteran wideout also spent most of last year on Indianapolis' practice squad but got into two regular season-games with the club. Treadwell's best NFL campaign came in 2021, when he caught 33 passes for 434 yards and a touchdown over 12 regular-season games with Jacksonville.

items.h: The Colts released Treadwell on Tuesday, Amanda Foster of the team's official site reports.
items.s: Treadwell opted to stay in Indianapolis on a futures deal in January after spending most of the 2024 campaign on the Colts' practice squad, though he did play in two regular-season games. The veteran wideout didn't stand out across the Colts' first two preseason games, but he made his case for the 53-man roster during Saturday's preseason finale against the Bengals, when he caught six passes on as many targets for 116 yards and a touchdown. It ultimately wasn't enough for Treadwell to make the cut, but the 2016 first-rounder could stick around on the Colts' practice squad for a second…

items.h: Treadwell brought in all six targets for 116 yards and a touchdown in the Colts' 41-14 preseason win over the Bengals on Saturday afternoon.
items.s: The 2016 first-round pick of the Vikings has never come close to living up to his pedigree, although Treadwell has found a way to remain gainfully employed in the NFL for nine seasons. Saturday, the veteran opened the game with the starters for the afternoon and made an impact by snagging a 22-yard grab on the opening possession and eventually recording a 49-yard touchdown grab just before halftime. Treadwell didn't log any targets over two regular-season games with the Colts in 2024 and has never topped 35 receptions or 434 yards in any campaign, but his 7-140-1 receiving line on 10 targets…

items.h: Indianapolis signed Treadwell to a reserve/futures contract Monday.
items.s: Treadwell spent the 2024 campaign on the Colts' practice squad and was elevated for two regular-season games, but he wasn't targeted in either contest. The veteran wideout will spend the offseason competing to again earn a reserve role for the 2025 season.

items.h: Treadwell reverted to Indianapolis' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
items.s: Treadwell received his second elevation of the campaign for Sunday's matchup versus New England and tallied seven offensive snaps along with 12 special-teams snaps without recording any other stats. The veteran's opportunity was a result of Josh Downs sitting out due to a shoulder injury and Ashton Dulin missing the game due to an ankle issue. The Colts are on bye Week 14, which could give Downs and Dulin time to recover, in turn potentially lowering Treadwell's chance of receiving another elevation.

items.h: Treadwell reverted to the Colts' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
items.s: The wide receiver was elevated to the active roster for Sunday's 30-20 loss to the Bills with Michael Pittman out with back and finger injuries. Treadwell was still buried behind Josh Downs, Alec Pierce, Ashton Dulin, Adonai Mitchell and Anthony Gould, and he did not play an offensive snap, though he did see seven snaps on special teams. Treadwell caught one pass for 16 yards and no scores in five games with Baltimore in 2023.

items.h: The Colts elevated Treadwell from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's matchup against Buffalo, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
items.s: This is Treadwell's first elevation of the season, and it corresponds with Indianapolis' top wideout Michael Pittman being ruled out against the Bills due to a back injury and a finger injury. Treadwell played in five games with Baltimore last season, recording one catch on three targets for 16 yards. The veteran receiver isn't likely to see much action on offense against Buffalo on Sunday, as the Colts' wideout corps will likely be led by Josh Downs and Alec Pierce, with Ashton Dulin, Adonai Mitchell and Anthony Gould also possibly ahead of Treadwell in the pecking order.

items.h: The Colts signed Treadwell to the practice squad Wednesday.
items.s: Treadwell was unable to make Indianapolis' final roster but will stick around with the team on its practice squad. The 2016 first-round pick caught just one pass for 16 yards in five games for the Ravens last season, and can add value on both offense and special teams if elevated to the active roster.

items.h: Treadwell was released by the Colts on Tuesday, JJ Stankevitz of the team's official site reports.
items.s: Treadwell signed with the Colts in late July after appearing in five regular-season games for the Ravens in 2023. The 2016 first-round pick was competing for a depth wide receiver role in training camp. Treadwell's best outing came in the Colts' second preseason game against the Cardinals, when he caught all seven of his targets for 72 yards. His experience should warrant him an opportunity to link up with another team in need of a wide receiver, either on the active roster or practice squad.

items.h: Inks deal with Indianapolis
items.s: After a five-game stint with Baltimore in 2023, Treadwell has found a new home in Indianapolis. The one-time first-round pick has played with five different teams over the last five seasons, with his best year coming in 2021, when he posted a 33-431-1 receiving line with the Jaguars. He's expected to compete for a depth role in the Colts' wide receiver room as the offseason progresses.

items.h: The Ravens signed Treadwell to their practice squad Wednesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
items.s: Baltimore cut Treadwell from the active roster earlier in the week, but he's now back as postseason depth. He has one catch for 16 yards this season.

items.h: The Ravens waived Treadwell on Monday, Field Yates of ESPN reports.
items.s: The veteran wideout has appeared in five games for Baltimore this season, but he's losing his roster spot after bouncing between the practice squad and 53-man unit. Treadwell caught one pass for 16 yards on three targets in the Week 18 loss to the Steelers.

items.h: The Ravens signed Treadwell to their active roster Saturday.
items.s: The last of Treadwell's three practice squad elevations were used by Baltimore in Week 16, so he's been signed to the team's 53-man roster ahead of Sunday's affair. The 2016 first-round pick played all 17 of his snaps as a special-teamer on Christmas Day, and he'll likely assume the same role in Week 17.

items.h: Treadwell reverted to the Ravens' practice squad Tuesday.
items.s: Treadwell was elevated to the active roster before Monday's 33-19 win over the 49ers, but failed to record any stats while playing 17 snaps on special teams. The wide receiver will now have to wait for his next shot to join the Ravens for a contest.

items.h: Treadwell has been elevated to the Ravens' active roster for Monday's game against the 49ers.
items.s: Treadwell is being elevated for a third and final time, meaning in order for him to appear in another game with Baltimore the team will have to sign him to the 53-man roster. The veteran hasn't played since Week 5, and he wasn't targeted in either of his other appearances with Baltimore this year. Zay Flowers (foot) is questionable for Monday's game, while starters Rashod Bateman and Odell Beckham are both fully available for the Ravens.

items.h: The Ravens reverted Treadwell to their practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
items.s: Treadwell was elevated each of the past two weeks, though all of his work in Sunday's Week 5 loss to the Steelers came on special teams. He did see 15 offensive snaps Week 4 against Cleveland but didn't log any stats. Baltimore's wide receiver corps is mostly healthy with both Odell Beckham and Rashod Bateman returning against Pittsburgh, so there may not be room for Treadwell to see work on offense for the time being even if he is elevated again for Week 6.

items.h: Treadwell was elevated to the Ravens' active roster ahead of Sunday's game against Pittsburgh, Dale Lolley of the Steelers' official site reports.
items.s: Treadwell's elevation suggests that the Ravens will likely be without wideout Odell Beckham this coming Sunday. The 2016 first-round pick was active for Baltimore's Week 4 win over Cleveland, playing primarily on special teams.

items.h: Treadwell reverted to the Ravens' practice squad Monday.
items.s: Treadwell was elevated for Sunday's 28-3 win over the Browns, failing to record any stats while playing 15 snaps with the offense and 17 with the special-teams unit. The wide receiver could be asked to join the active roster again in Week 5 versus the Steelers if Odell Beckham (ankle) and/or Rashod Bateman (hamstring) are ruled out once again.

items.h: Tredwell was elevated to the Ravens' active roster Saturday.
items.s: The move corresponds with Odell Beckham (ankle) and Rashod Bateman (hamstring) both ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Browns. Treadwell will add depth to a depleted wide receiver corps behind rookie Zay Flowers and veterans Nelson Agholor and Devin Duvernay.

items.h: Treadwell plans to sign a practice squad deal with the Ravens on Wednesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
items.s: Treadwell missed out on a spot on the Ravens' 53-man roster ahead of the 2023 campaign, but it appears as though he'll land a role with the team's practice squad. The 2016 first-round pick appeared in six games with Seattle last year and secured six of 10 targets for 42 yards.

items.h: The Ravens signed Treadwell to a one-year deal Monday, Tom Pelissero of NFL Network reports.
items.s: Treadwell had a career-high 434 receiving yards over 12 appearances for the Jaguars in 2021, but he caught just six of 10 targets for 42 yards across six appearances with Seattle last year. In Baltimore, the 2016 first-round pick will compete for a Week 1 roster spot with a litany of new additions, including Nelson Agholor, Andy Isabella and Mike Thomas (shoulder).

items.h: Treadwell posted six catches (10 targets) for 42 yards through six regular-season games during the 2022 season. He wasn't targeted in his lone postseason outing.
items.s: Treadwell filled in when Tyler Lockett was out with a hand injury and logged an 85 percent snap share, but he posted just three catches for 26 yards. The 27-year-old receiver has played with four teams over the past four seasons. His best season was in 2021 when he posted a 33-434-1 line over 12 games with the Jaguars. He'll need to earn a roster spot in training camp wherever he lands next year.

items.h: Treadwell wasn't targeted and played just five offensive snaps in the 19-16 overtime win versus the Rams on Sunday.
items.s: Treadwell combined for 101 offensive snaps and nine targets through the previous two weeks, but he spent most of his time on the bench in the must-win divisional matchup while Cade Johnson and rookie Dareke Young split the No. 3 duties. It's unclear how the snaps will be split in the wild-card game versus the 49ers on Saturday. Treadwell could be back in the mix, but it looks like head coach Pete Carroll favors Johnson and Young for now.

items.h: Treadwell caught both of his targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 23-6 win over the Jets.
items.s: Tyler Lockett returned to the lineup but missed a major chunk of the game due to a leg injury, so Treadwell played 55 percent of the snaps. He handled an 85 percent share in Week 16. He appears to be the clear No. 3 in this offense right now because Marquise Goodwin (shoulder) is on injured reserve. However, Treadwell's role will be scaled back significantly if Lockett is healthy heading into Week 18 versus the Rams.

items.h: Treadwell caught three of seven targets for 26 yards in Saturday's 24-10 loss to the Chiefs.
items.s: Treadwell was signed off the practice squad following Tyler Lockett's hand injury. He surprisingly finished second on the team with 62 offensive snaps, landing ahead of Marquise Goodwin, who missed most of the third quarter with a wrist injury. Treadwell's target share is appealing for fantasy purposes, but he'll likely revert to the No. 3 role if Goodwin is fully healthy in Week 17 versus the Jets.

items.h: Seattle signed Treadwell from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
items.s: Treadwell has been elevated for three consecutive games with Dee Eskridge (hand) on injured reserve, catching his lone target for one yard across 29 offensive snaps. However, with Tyler Lockett (finger) also out now, Treadwell will get a spot on the active roster for the remainder of the regular season. He figures to compete with Dareke Young and Penny Hart for the No. 3 spot behind DK Metcalf and Marquise Goodwin until Lockett is able to return.

items.h: Treadwell reverted to the Seahawks' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
items.s: With Dee Eskridge (hand) still on injured reserve, Treadwell was elevated from the practice squad for the third game in a row versus Carolina. However, the 27-year-old ultimately played just four of his 13 snaps on offense, and he has now logged just one target over his three appearances this season. It's unlikely that Seattle will choose to sign Treadwell to the active roster after utilizing his last available elevation from the practice squad Week 14.

items.h: Seattle elevated Treadwell from its practice squad to the 53-man roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's game versus Carolina, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
items.s: Treadwell is set to suit up for a third consecutive week, meaning the Seahawks will need to sign him to the active roster if they need him to play beyond Week 14. The 27-year-old wideout has caught his only target for one yard through two games in 2022.

items.h: Treadwell reverted to the Seahawks' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
items.s: Treadwell saw 18 snaps on offense for Seattle in their win over the Rams on Sunday. He caught his only target for one-yard, while chipping in on special teams. He'll work to earn another elevation for Week 14 against the Panthers.

items.h: Seattle activated Treadwell from its practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's game at the Rams, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.
items.s: Treadwell will join the Seahawks' 53-man roster for a second consecutive game, and after Sunday he'll be eligible for just one more elevation before he would have to be signed to the team's active roster in order to suit up. He played just seven offensive snaps in Week 12.
